subject: Render DELTA6 READY: 4-slot RT2-only MRT + inert PSO flag; per-RT transport
body:
DELTA6 render implementation is ready for review, no commit.

Implemented render-owned files:
- render_pipeline.inc: up to 4 contiguous colour attachments in the generic fallback, differing formats/masks/blends, genericRtCount/Active/Formats/Masks/Blends, mainRT first non-zero mask, per-RT shaders; TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES (default off) nonnil inert PSO with bounded draw refusal.
- nord2_render_pass.inc: 4 target slots, holes/RT0/RT1 unbound, per-target format/load/clear/job state, dimensions matched but formats may differ.
- render_encoder.inc: per-target jobs via SELECT_RT, target-specific formats/rows/load/clear/blend, RT2-only unbound path; exact refusal for cross-target fetch of a target already written; same-target n2r attachment snapshot; inert draw trace.
- compositor_submit.inc: R8 target format10 routes through n2mb_draw_v3 (compute R8 route); n2r_draw_options TLS fields initialized zero.
- ws_selector_compat unchanged from delta5.

ACK: compute final message confirms per-RT v3 is the bounded render path and v4 is optional; textures n2r v4 exists. This implementation deliberately does not wire v4. No n2r/bridge source edits by render.

HOST: python3 build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/render/host_test_vs_texture.py rc0 both fake-JM binaries under ASan+UBSan. Real path_cubic RT2-only 4-attachment (BGRA,BGRA,R8,BGRA masks0,0,15,0) builds generic-mrt and commits status4 (4 clears + 1 RT2 job); same PSO with RT0/RT1 unbound commits (RT2 clear + draw). Inert flag-on binary returns nonnil inert PSO, refuses draws with TEGU_INERT_DRAW_REFUSED and no job; flag-off stub returns nil/error. Prior delta5/delta4 tests pass. ARM64 JM -Werror syntax default+inert PASS; diffcheck clean.

EXPLICIT GAPS:
- path_blit (writes 0,1,2 and fetches attachment2) does not pass per-target shader preparation; no false draw is claimed. True-MRT v4/target snapshots would be needed.
- Per-attachment blend/write-mask multi-output draw behavior is not host-tested.
- formats outside n2r_bpp 10/70/80/115 remain translator/packer refusals; warmup list not captured.
- raw n2r_build_v2 2-level fixture currently returns BAD while validation accepts; worker test retains sidecar/validation, raw builder not claimed (textures/compute).
- no native/phone/publish/commit. Please review ownership of nord2_render_pass.inc and the flag default-off policy.
